newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy little changed in thin session.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy little changed in thin session.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices changed little in quiet ACCESS trade, with activity limited by social events at the NYMEX futures exchange.
"It's dead. Volume has been way down," a trader said.
In daytime trade, unleaded gasoline for June delivery ended 0.35 cnets a gallon lower at 64.04 cents. June crude eased nine cents a barrel during the day, while heating oil edged up 0.06 cents.
On ACCESS, the overnight market, June crude oil gained one cent to $20.31 a barrel, while unleaded rose 0.06 cents a gallon to 64.10 cents.
Volumes for June crude stood at 133 lots by 1930 EDT/0230 GMT. Total volume was 380 lots. Unleaded gasoline saw a light 13 lots change hands in June with 18 in all months.
June heating oil rose 0.12 cents a gallon afterhours.
Volume for heating oil was 75 lots in June, and 85 lots overall.
